title: Fondamantal
label: Music & Media Platform
summary: A modular ecosystem for streaming, album experiences, broadcasting, and internal content management under one brand-owned platform.
overview: Fondamantal is a modular music and media platform built to centralize content ownership, presentation, and internal operations—reducing dependency on fragmented third-party tools. The platform serves as both a public-facing media hub and an operational backbone for content publishing.
problem: Independent artists face fragmented distribution, limited brand control, and a lack of internal operational tooling when relying entirely on external platforms. Managing releases across multiple services creates friction and reduces long-term content ownership.
approach: Designed a platform-first architecture with distinct but connected subsystems
Separated public experiences (library, albums, broadcast) from internal tools (admin dashboard)
Built a consistent design language shared across all platform components
Prioritized modular structure to allow independent evolution of each system
Established scalable content patterns for future expansion
Focused on brand ownership over third-party dependencies
keyFeatures: Modular platform architecture where systems evolve independently
Brand-controlled media experience across all touchpoints
Clear separation between public and internal systems
Unified streaming library with custom playback controls
First-party broadcast layer for announcements and updates
Purpose-built admin dashboard for content management
Consistent UX language across the entire ecosystem
Scalable content structure designed for long-term growth
technicalNotes: React / Next.js for component-based frontend architecture
Server-side rendering for performance and SEO
Modular component library shared across subsystems
Custom audio player implementation for brand control
Responsive layout system supporting mobile through desktop
Structured data patterns for content scalability
Clean separation of concerns between public and admin contexts
outcomes: Centralized platform supporting releases, audience engagement, and internal workflows
Reduced dependency on third-party distribution platforms
Unified brand experience across all content touchpoints
Operational independence for content publishing without developer intervention
Foundation established for future monetization and feature expansion
